parameters.name: IgnoreFailedNodeTasks
parameters.description: Specifies whether to allow skipping failed nodes. Default value: False.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo-controller reboot-nodes --cluster-id i15b480fbd2fcdbc2869cd80 --nodes i138475611663639202234 --ignore-failed-node-tasks false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eflo-controller RebootNodes --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId i15b480fbd2fcdbc2869cd80 --IgnoreFailedNodeTasks false --Nodes '["i138475611663639202234"]'
